title: Connected TV Attribution & Incrementality: Complete Measurement Guide for DTC Brands

facts.fact: The page says DTC brands investing $50K+ monthly in CTV need to prove incrementality and understand true attribution.
facts.quote: For DTC brands investing $50K+ monthly in CTV, proving incrementality and understanding true attribution is critical for scaling campaigns profitably.

facts.fact: The vendor states its guide is based on $75M+ in annual CTV spend across 200+ DTC campaigns.
facts.quote: based on $75M+ in annual CTV spend across 200+ DTC campaigns

facts.fact: The page claims platform reporting often shows 40-70% lower conversions than reality, without citing a source.
facts.quote: Platform reporting often shows 40-70% lower conversions than reality

facts.fact: The page says traditional 1-day attribution windows miss most conversions and recommends extended attribution periods of 14-30+ days for CTV.
facts.quote: Need for extended attribution periods (14-30+ days)

facts.fact: The page recommends configuring The Trade Desk's extended attribution windows at 14-30 days.
The page's example attribution configuration sets the CTV view-through window at 14-30 days.
The page's example attribution configuration sets the email click window at 3 days.
The page says marketing mix modeling requires daily sales data covering at least 2 years.
The page's geo-holdout design calls for 20+ matched market pairs.
The page says geo-holdout tests typically need $100K+ monthly spend to ensure sufficient statistical power.
facts.quote: Ensure sufficient statistical power (typically need $100K+ monthly spend)

facts.fact: The page's geo-holdout design reduces CTV in the control group by 50-80%.
facts.quote: Control Group: CTV advertising paused or reduced by 50-80%

facts.fact: The page says geo-holdout tests should run a minimum of 6-12 weeks for statistical significance.
facts.quote: Duration: 6-12 weeks minimum for statistical significance

facts.fact: The page sets a p-value threshold of below 0.05 for determining statistical significance in incrementality tests.
For beauty/skincare, the page lists a 14-day primary attribution window.
For beauty/skincare, the page says a 28-day extended window captures 85%+ of conversions.
For apparel, the page lists a 21-day primary attribution window and a 45-day extended window.
For home/garden, the page lists a 30-day primary attribution window and a 60-day extended window.
The page's audience segment design defines heavy CTV exposure as 8+ impressions per person per week.
facts.quote: **Heavy Exposure:** 8+ impressions per person per week

facts.fact: The page's linear time-decay example gives 100% attribution value on day 1 and 0% on day 14.
The page lists ghost ad serving as supported by The Trade Desk and Samsung.
facts.quote: Use platforms that support ghost ad serving (The Trade Desk, Samsung)
